# MyHotelBox

> The most complete Property Management System (PMS) for independent hotels, apartments, and small hospitality groups. 95+ production modules spanning front office, billing, revenue, guest communications, compliance, and AI — designed to meet or exceed the feature set of Mews, Cloudbeds, and Eviivo.

MyHotelBox is a modern, full-stack hotel platform that gives independent operators enterprise-grade capabilities without the enterprise price tag. It combines a React + Tailwind UI with a FastAPI + MongoDB backend, and ships with AI integrations (Claude Sonnet 4.5, GPT-5.2, Gemini Nano Banana) for revenue optimisation, guest concierge, and content generation.

## Who it's for

- Independent hotels (1-200 rooms) wanting Mews/Cloudbeds feature parity at a lower TCO
- Multi-property portfolios with mixed currencies and mixed brand identities
- Short-stay apartment operators, hostels, and aparthotels
- Finance teams that need proper corporate AR, multi-currency GL consolidation, and GDPR tooling

## Core capabilities

### Front office
- Gantt-style drag-and-drop calendar with collision detection and overbooking alerts
- One-click duplicate booking, no-show, check-in/out, cancel
- Out-of-Service / Maintenance blocks with diagonal-striped overlays
- Self-Service Kiosk (`/checkin-kiosk`) for passport-scan check-in

### Billing & finance
- Split folios with per-sub-folio Print / Email / Set-Payer
- City Ledger (Corporate AR) with 30/60/90-day aging
- Multi-currency consolidation — 41 ISO currencies, live FX, portfolio-wide reporting
- Multi-currency line items on a single invoice (e.g. room in EUR + F&B in USD rolled up to GBP)
- Full Tax Configuration (VAT, city tax, tourist tax, resort fee, OTA included-in-rate logic)
- Deposit Policies with priority-based rule evaluator
- Profit OS (ContributionPAR) — revenue net of OTA commission + payment processing fees

### Commercial / revenue
- Rate Products (BAR, Non-Refundable, Advance Purchase, Corporate, Package)
- Derived rates (child rates that float ±% or ±£ from a parent)
- OTA channel-code mapping UI (Booking.com, Expedia, Airbnb, Hotels.com, Agoda)
- Promo codes with validate hook for the booking engine
- AI Revenue Copilot (Claude Sonnet) for pricing decisions
- Demand Radar, Compset, Price Alerts, Dynamic Pricing

### Guest communications
- Unified Inbox: WhatsApp + SMS + Email + Booking.com + Airbnb merged per-guest
- Manual click-to-send communications (never automated without explicit operator action)
- Pre-arrival digital check-in + upsell engine

### Groups
- Link multiple rooms to one organiser (weddings, conferences, tour groups)
- Three billing modes: master-pays-all, master-pays-rooms-only, each-room-self-pays
- Consolidated Master Folio view

### Compliance
- RBAC v2 with 313 granular permissions, sidebar gating, and permission-denial audit trail
- GDPR Article 17 (erasure) and Article 20 (portability) fully implemented
- Legal document e-signing, registration cards with passport + signature capture

### AI
- AI Weekly Digest (natural-language P&L summary)
- Smart Scanner (mobile ID OCR)
- Event Intelligence (auto-detects concerts/festivals and surfaces pricing pressure)
- Concierge Analytics (intent mining across guest conversations)

## Integrations

- **LLMs**: Claude Sonnet 4.5, GPT-5.2, Gemini 3 Pro (via the Emergent Universal Key)
- **Image/video**: Nano Banana, Sora 2, GPT Image 1
- **Payments**: Stripe (including crypto)
- **Email**: Resend
- **Voice**: ElevenLabs, OpenAI TTS & Whisper
- **Channels**: Booking.com, Expedia, Airbnb, Hotels.com, Agoda

## Comparison

See `/compare` for a full feature audit of MyHotelBox vs Mews vs Cloudbeds vs Eviivo. Score (2×full + 1×partial): MyHotelBox **70**, Mews 50, Cloudbeds 38, Eviivo 23.

## Technical

- Frontend: React 19 · Tailwind CSS · Shadcn/UI · Lucide icons
- Backend: FastAPI · Python 3.11 · MongoDB (Motor async driver)
- Auth: JWT-based with Emergent-managed Google OAuth option
- 100% test pass rate across 153 testing iterations
